context:
Goal: old drafts (Nov 12 to 13) get merged with main and handed in without a repeat review (your 20:17 CST Nov 14 goal: max efficiency, accurate, fastest).
Problem (rule): two rules clash on one file, docs/records.md (the generated page). n=2 so far (PRs #2852 and #2932); more of the 12 rebase lanes may follow. These drafts carry an old edit to the page from before the merge tool rebuilt the page at merge. A merge of main keeps that edit with no conflict. The records-page guard then refuses any commit whose page is not main's own page; the `--fix-check` rule (pr-review-record) refuses a head that edits any path beyond git's own merge result, and the page is such a path. A conflicted page (like #3435's) is allowed by both. So these two drafts cannot get a fix-check record. Only you can pick which rule gives way.
Based on (read): lane messages 23:40 and 23:41 CST Nov 14 with the tool's exact refusal words ("a merge that conflicts may edit its conflicted paths only"); both earlier logs are round 3 PASS plus a PASS fix check (comments 6860849629 on #2852, 6858733948 on #2932). Peers' reads, relayed by the coordinator at 23:42 CST; triage has not read the comments.
Based on (ruling): own-840-a-ready-merges-main-skip-page-commits (your 19:56 CST Nov 14 answer a: the review record's walk skips page-only commits). Triage read the ruling, not the walk's code: whether it covers a records-only difference in a merge commit is unknown. No ruling of yours names this case.
Based on (measured): a fresh review costs about 25 minutes of three reviewer rounds per affected PR (round times 7.1 to 7.9 min, n=3).
Third path, from the first lane (pick-ack-ruling-2, PR #2932, 23:27 CST): you type `override` in that lane's session for the one commit. This item's earlier form asked only that; it covers one commit, not the class. An override must be typed by you in the lane's session: the page save alone is not that line.
Departs from: main - a fix check on a merge head accepts only git's own merge result; (a) makes the check ignore a difference in docs/records.md, (b) keeps the check as it is.
Meanwhile: the lanes hold. If the consultant answers b, or there is no answer 15 minutes after the page save, the lanes start the fresh reviews (read-only, undoable). Updated 23:42 CST Nov 14 from the coordinator's 23:42 message.

lastAnswer.note: b, the consultant's pick (its reading of your 20:18 words, not typed by you; relayed by the coordinator 23:43 CST): lanes start fresh full reviews now in parallel; one lane also tests whether restoring main's page before the merge lets --fix-check pass. Reopens if you say otherwise.

options.gain: No repeat review: about 25 minutes of three reviewer rounds saved per affected PR (round times 7.1 to 7.9 min, n=3).
options.label: The fix-check source gate ignores differences in docs/records.md, because the page is regenerated at merge
options.lose: A shared check accepts one more form. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.gain: No tool change; the check stays as it is.
options.label: Each affected lane posts a fresh full review (rounds 1 to 3 again, no Fix check line; allowed after round 3)
options.lose: About 25 minutes per affected PR, sequential reviewer rounds.

short: Old drafts' records page: ignore it in the fix check, or fresh reviews?
title: Old drafts carry an old docs/records.md edit and cannot get a fix-check record. Make the fix check ignore the page (a), or post a fresh full review per draft (b)?
why: Only you can let a shared check accept a form it refuses today; the coordinator recommends b, which changes no tool.
